title: Incident: duplicate OrderPaid

answer.root_cause: The idempotency check in handle_payment_webhook is performed at the start, but the webhook is only marked as processed after the OrderPaid event is inserted into the outbox and the order is marked paid. If a retry occurs before _mark_processed(webhook_id) completes (e.g., due to a crash or timeout), the next request will pass the _already_processed check and insert a duplicate OrderPaid event.

title: Incident: lost outbox events

answer.root_cause: The worker calls `outbox.ack()` before calling `publish()`. If the publisher crashes after acking but before publishing, the event is marked as processed (`acked=True`) and will never be retried by `claim_batch`, causing it to disappear.

title: Constrained fix: webhook idempotency

plan_steps: Move the call to _mark_processed(webhook_id) from line 43 to immediately after the check for _already_processed(webhook_id) at line 26.
This ensures that if a concurrent request with the same webhook_id arrives, it will be caught by _already_processed before OrderPaid is inserted into the outbox or order_service.mark_paid is called.
answer.idempotency_change: _mark_processed(webhook_id) moves from after side-effects (outbox/order_service) to before them, immediately following the _already_processed check.
